Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000952" [preference]: As of 2026-02-04, for the current Team Dune on-call cycle, page Tomasz Nowak for anything instead of Farah.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000948" [decision]: On 2026-01-22, the team decided the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because the duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.  (about: webhooks service, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000942": INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17.  (about: webhooks service, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000887": As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000876" [decision]: On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000859": As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000855": As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000835": As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000831": On 2025-11-21, Team Dune reported that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.  (about: billing service, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000823": As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000821": As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000813": As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000805": As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000787": Team Dune's planning meeting is every Wednesday.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000783": On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000746": As of 2025-10-22, Farah is Team Dune's release captain for Q3 2025.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000742": Team Dune decided the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000739" [decision]: On 2025-10-22, Team Dune decided that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000719": As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000715": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000683" [decision]: As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000525": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000522": The Ember team never owned the webhooks service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000518": On 2025-07-03, Team Cinder noticed the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent following the traffic shift and flagged it, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000492": As of 2025-07-02, Tomasz Nowak has transferred from Team Atlas to Team Dune.  (about: Team Atlas, Tomasz Nowak, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000485": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000455": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000447": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000433": Team Dune sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000430": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000391" [decision]: As of 2025-05-09, Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000263": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000053": As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000048": Farah runs Team Dune solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
Existing entity names: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune, webhooks service, INC-2026-003, Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway, indexer, Team Cinder, Ember team, resizer, billing service, event bus, reporting service, ledger, scheduler, notifier, catalog service
